items.name: Todoist
items.description: Your Todoist tasks on Today. Tick one on the dashboard and it's done in Todoist.

items.name: Calendar
items.description: Your calendars on the agenda, read from their secret iCal addresses. Recurring events and moved ones included.

items.name: Mail
items.description: Reads up to three mailboxes over IMAP, read-only, and sends new mail and your replies to triage.

items.name: WhatsApp
items.description: Your WhatsApp chats go to triage. Runs a WAHA bridge for each number; link a number by scanning its QR code in the panel. Read only: it never sends or marks anything read.

items.name: PoliTO
items.description: Course avvisi and school messages from the Politecnico di Torino as cards, and deadlines on the agenda. Closing a card marks it read on PoliTO.

items.name: Shipments
items.description: Your parcels at a glance, from the shipping mails you already get. A card when one arrives today or waits at a pickup point.

items.name: Plan my day
items.description: Fits your to-dos into your free time. A draft for tomorrow every evening; nothing goes in your calendar until you approve it.
